decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction + Target and the cordis.patch.yml link: marker to show the repo tree IS the installed copy; copy step is unnecessary/self-copy; distinguishes copied installs via blank LinkType.

Attributes both EBUSY handles and stale module state to the running host; closing a tab releases nothing; separates browser HTTP cache (needs hard refresh) from host restart, and does not generalize serving behavior.

Explains rename through junction renamed the sole physical files, making the source copy fail; restores .old2 files by rename preserving contents, node --checks both, then activates; host stop is a valid precaution.
Order: edit, node --check, fully stop host, start host, hard-refresh bypassing cache, then verify 200/new marker, feature behavior, and new host route — not syntax check alone, not browser-only.

Gives both read-only probes (LinkType/Target, cordis.patch.yml link: marker) to run before any file operation, picks procedure by install mode, and explains why copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly rejects copying through the junction as a category error and never deletes the .old2 files; bad copy advice appears only as rejected example.
Plan requires full host stop/restart before activation and explicitly states the browser need not be closed; refresh-alone claims appear only as refuted explanations.
